headline: Staatsolie and Petronas Take FID on $1.6B Suriname Gas Project
summary: Staatsolie and Petronas reached a final investment decision on Suriname's first offshore gas project, with first LNG expected in mid-2030.
why: Major offshore energy investments establish new hydrocarbon export streams and shape long-term economic growth for emerging producers.

impacts.name: Suriname
impacts.why: A $1.6 billion offshore gas investment generates significant long-term export revenues and foreign investment for Suriname.
